--- pipe_tablesample.sql
FROM LargeTable |> TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (1 PERCENT)

--- AST
&ast.QueryStatement{
  Query: &ast.Query{
    Query: &ast.FromQuery{
      From: &ast.From{
        Source: &ast.TableName{
          Table: &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 5,
            NameEnd: 15,
            Name:    "LargeTable",
          },
        },
      },
    },
    PipeOperators: []ast.PipeOperator{
      &ast.PipeTableSample{
        Pipe:   16,
        Sample: &ast.TableSample{
          TableSample: 19,
          Method:      "BERNOULLI",
          Size:        &ast.TableSampleSize{
            Lparen: 41,
            Rparen: 51,
            Value:  &ast.IntLiteral{
              ValuePos: 42,
              ValueEnd: 43,
              Base:     10,
              Value:    "1",
            },
            Unit: "PERCENT",
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
FROM LargeTable |> TABLESAMPLE BERNOULLI (1 PERCENT)
